projects.title: Collect the Gems
projects.description: Build a 3D rolling ball game where the player collects floating gems within a time limit. Introduces physics, triggers, UI, and basic input.

projects.title: Maze Runner
projects.description: Create a first-person maze navigation game with keys, doors, enemies, and a finish line. Deepens scripting, animation, audio, and scene management.

projects.title: Space Blaster
projects.description: Develop a 2D top-down space shooter with waves of enemies, power-ups, a UI menu, and audio mixer integration. Culminates with a WebGL build.
